caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped metal tub with two side handles. The tub is primarily colored gray with a shiny metallic texture on its inner surface. The upper edge and base of the exterior are bordered with an orange-red band featuring gold ornamental patterns and yellow trim. On the front center section of the tub, within the gray area, there is a detailed illustration of a yellow vase filled with various colorful flowers, including red, pink, and white blossoms, and green foliage. Another decorative element, a green and yellow rosette, is visible on the orange-red band near the center. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, and the artist's name, "John. H. Tercuzzi.," is written in the lower left corner with a small number "38" in the lower right corner.
title: Painted Basin
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
